create.name: Michael Anderson
create.bio:
Michael Anderson is an art teacher and meditation instructor who lives in Vienna, where he runs Art of Being, a small practice that brings contemplative meditation and art-making together. Born in Minnesota, he spent around twenty-five years teaching art in schools in several countries and began meditating in 2005. He later trained as a meditation teacher through the Tibet House US and Dharma Moon programme and qualified to teach the eight-week MBSR course, and he also has family roots in Sicily, where he leads his residential retreats.

His starting point is that everyone is an artist and that a few minutes of settled attention make room for honest creative work. In Vienna he holds small workshops, taught in English, in which guided mindfulness opens into drawing or map-making, as well as unhurried museum visits built around looking at a handful of works in silence, and walking practice in parks and gardens. Online he offers self-paced programmes, among them a three-day home retreat filmed on a Sicilian estate and a course on the monastic hours inspired by Brother David Steindl-Rast, plus one-to-one introductions to meditation. He teaches in English, German and Spanish.

courses.title: Home Retreat: An Online Mindful Art Retreat from the Heart of Sicily
courses.description: A self-paced three-day retreat filmed at a country estate in Sicily, pairing guided mindfulness sessions with simple art exercises. No experience of art or meditation is needed, and enrolment includes a live video call with Michael.

courses.title: Book of Hours: Finding Natural Time in a Hurried World
courses.description: A self-paced programme that takes the monastic hours of the day, from vigils to compline, as a frame for contemplation. Each week brings a reflection, a meditation, an art prompt and a poem, with one live video session included; it is non-sectarian.

courses.title: 1:1 Mindfulness Meditation Introduction
courses.description: A one-hour private online session covering posture, attention to body and breath, working with thoughts and setting up a daily routine. A six-session package over ninety days is available afterwards.

courses.title: Mindful Breaks: Short Practices for Young Hearts and Minds
courses.description: Three short video practices written with young people in mind, including mindful breathing, a mindful snack and a pebble meditation from the Plum Village tradition, with materials for teachers and parents.

courses.title: Art of Being Workshops
courses.description: Small in-person workshops in Vienna for up to ten people, held in English, where a guided mindfulness practice leads into drawing, mark-making or map-making. Materials are provided and no art background is required.
